test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 14 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: At the same time A and B start moving towards each other from two different places, 240 km apart. The ratio of the speeds of A and B is 5 : 7, and the speed of B is 84 km/h. After how many minutes will A and B meet each other?
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of speeds **A : B = 5 : 7**

Given speed of **B = 84 km/h** ⇒ 7 units = 84 ⇒ 1 unit = 12 km/h

Total speed (Relative) = (5 + 7) units = 12 × 12 = **144 km/h**

Time = (Distance ÷ Relative Speed) × 60 = (240 ÷ 144) × 60 = **100 min**

**∴ The correct answer is 100 min.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Distance = 240 km, Speed Ratio (A:B) = 5 : 7, Speed of B = 84 km/h.

**Formula Used:** Time = Distance ÷ Relative Speed; 1 hour = 60 minutes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e892a548e98792b7bc63895e0d3b3b4c6375c74f6ff34853cab5ac271e814439.png] 

⇒ Speed of **B** = 84 km/h

⇒ Ratio **A : B** = 5 : 7

⇒ Speed of **A** = (84 ÷ 7) × 5 = 12 × 5 = 60 km/h

⇒ **Relative Speed** (Opposite Direction) = Speed of A + Speed of B

⇒ Relative Speed = 60 + 84 = 144 km/h

⇒ **Time to meet** (in hours) = Distance ÷ Relative Speed

⇒ Time = 240 ÷ 144 = 5/3 hours

⇒ Time in minutes = (5 ÷ 3) × 60

⇒ Time = 5 × 20 = 100 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 100 min.**

**__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed in Opposite Direction

When two objects move towards each other, their relative speed is the **sum** of their individual speeds: Sᵣₑₗ = S₁ + S₂.

Relative Speed in Same Direction

When two objects move in the same direction, their relative speed is the **difference** of their speeds: Sᵣₑₗ = |S₁ − S₂|.

Meeting Time Formula

Time taken to meet = (Initial distance between them) ÷ (Relative Speed).</p
